title: Copyright strike: 15 minutes to appeal
scenario: Your creator account gets a DM saying a copyright complaint will remove your profile unless you appeal within 15 minutes. The account sending it has a platform-style name and logo.

answers.A: Take a screenshot and ask a trusted adult or experienced creator to help verify the message.
answers.B: Use the appeal link but stop if it asks for anything beyond your normal login.
answers.C: Check your account’s official notifications or help center directly instead of using the DM link.

explanation: Fake moderation messages work because losing an account feels urgent. Real enforcement should be visible in the platform itself.
proTip: Account panic is exactly when to leave the DM.
